difficulty.description: How hard this case is for a law-trained, non-specialist reviewer to check: whether each judged item's call by the alignment judge is right, wrong or unsure.

score.description: An integer from 1 to 10. 1-3 easy (about half an hour or less, reviewer ends confident), 4-6 intermediate, 7-10 hard (about an hour and a half or more, or the reviewer may still be unsure). Must agree with `difficulty`.

estimated_minutes.description: Estimated total review time for this case in minutes, reading included.

factors.description: How much each factor adds to the reviewer's work in THIS case.

level.description: How much this factor adds to the reviewer's work in this case.

note.description: One sentence specific to this case: name the provision, term or background involved.

transaction_background.description: How much of the deal, the parties and who wants what procedurally must be learned before any item can be decided.

level.description: How much this factor adds to the reviewer's work in this case.

note.description: One sentence specific to this case: name the provision, term or background involved.

domain_knowledge.description: Specialised knowledge needed beyond general contract law: financial instruments, an industry's regulation, arbitration rules, a line of precedent.

level.description: How much this factor adds to the reviewer's work in this case.

note.description: One sentence specific to this case: name the provision, term or background involved.

defect_spread.description: Whether the court's defects sit in one phrase of one clause, or span several provisions or another document, so the contract must be reread.

level.description: How much this factor adds to the reviewer's work in this case.

note.description: One sentence specific to this case: name the provision, term or background involved.

agent_claims.description: Whether the agent's issues are single checkable claims, or multi-step, bundled, or carry factual claims that must be verified.

level.description: How much this factor adds to the reviewer's work in this case.

note.description: One sentence specific to this case: name the provision, term or background involved.

judge_call.description: Whether the judge's call can be confirmed by seeing that both sides point at the same words, or needs interpretation: relational defects, misses that the agent may have found on a neighbouring provision, unclear whether two descriptions are one defect.

level.description: How much this factor adds to the reviewer's work in this case.

note.description: One sentence specific to this case: name the provision, term or background involved.

volume.description: How many items there are to decide, and how much text must be read.

hardest_item.description: The id of the judged item that will take longest (e.g. "j03"), and in one or two sentences why. If there are no judged items, say so.

reason.description: Three to five sentences that someone deciding which reviewer should take this case could act on.
